title: Rotational Kinetic Energy
text: To calculate the Earth's rotational kinetic energy, use the formula for rotational kinetic energy: $$KE=\tfrac12I\omega**2$$.

title: Moment of Inertia of Earth
text: The Earth can be approximated as a solid sphere, so its moment of inertia is $$I=\tfrac25mr**2,$$ where $$m=5.97\times10**{24}\,\text{kg}$$ is the mass of the Earth and $$r=6.378\times10**{6}\,\text{m}$$ is its radius.

title: Angular Velocity of Earth
text: The Earth completes one rotation every $$24\, \text{h}$$ (86400 s), so its angular velocity is $$\omega=\frac{2\pi}{T}$$.
